title: How did you started visiting TheMallWorld?
content: The first time I started to remember TheMallWorld, it was because I was having dreams of going to TheMallWorld in School Trips, years after I graduated. I would see a mixture of high school and college friends, and with my lucid dreaming I started to room off from the group and start my own excursion. At first it was a “normal mall” again a mixture of different town malls and some I haven’t even seen. Funny thing, that wasn’t my first time dreaming of TheMallWorld, I used to had dreams of roaming empty malls or closed malls, I always assumed It was some type of anxiety dream. I stoped having that dream for a long period of time or stopped remembering them (who knows), and then the schools trips unlocked everything for me. I don’t have that type of scenario in my dream no more, sometimes it feels I’m having multiple dreams at the same time. It’s like TheMallWorld is a book and every chapter its a part of theMallWorld and everyday Im reading a different chapter or jumping from chapter to chapter. I can remember where it was left off if it makes sense. Be completely open to share your story! I’m looking forward to know more about us! 🍀
